cases.title: 췌장 MRI f/u
cases.text:
Pancreas MRI/MRCP f/u
임상: BD-IPMN f/u
비교: 2025-06-24 MRI (2.2 cm), 2024-06-20 MRI (1.9 cm)

판독소견:
Pancreas head/uncinate의 multilocular cyst, 현재 2.9 cm (이전 2.2 cm) — 1년간 7 mm 증가.
MPD 8 mm로 확장 (이전 4 mm).
Enhancing mural nodule 없음.
Pancreatic parenchymal atrophy 없음.

결론:
BD-IPMN (or mixed-type), interval growth 및 MPD 8 mm 확장 → worrisome features.

권고: EUS 및 췌장외과 협진 권함.

cases.title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast
cases.text:
CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
History: Hematuria. Former smoker.
Comparison: None.

Findings:
Liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenals: unremarkable.
Kidneys: No mass, no stone. Mild bilateral cortical thinning.
Ureters/bladder: Mild diffuse bladder wall thickening, likely related to underdistension / BPH.
Aorta: Fusiform infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring 4.2 x 4.0 cm (outer wall to outer wall), with mural thrombus. No periaortic stranding. Iliac arteries 1.4 cm.
Bowel: Sigmoid diverticulosis without diverticulitis.
Nodes: None enlarged.
Bones: Degenerative changes.

Impression:
1. 4.2 cm infrarenal AAA. Surveillance ultrasound in 12 months is recommended (SVS).
2. No renal mass or urolithiasis. Cystoscopy per urology for hematuria w/u.
3. Sigmoid diverticulosis.
cases.teaches: MedGemma adds the urology cystoscopy for haematuria, which no rule tracks.

Pelvis MRI (with Gd, DWI)

Lt ovary: 정상, follicle 수개.
Uterus: 2 cm intramural myoma.
Ascites, peritoneal implant 없음.

Imp)

cases.title: 요추 MRI
cases.text:
L-spine MRI (non-enhanced)
임상: LBP with Rt leg radiating pain.

판독소견:
L4-5: central to Rt subarticular disc protrusion → Rt L5 nerve root compression.
L5-S1: mild disc bulging, neural foraminal stenosis 없음.
Vertebral body marrow signal 정상.
Incidental: Lt kidney lower pole 2.5 cm T2 homogeneous hyperintense, thin wall lesion → simple cyst (Bosniak I) 가능성 높음. f/u 불필요.

결론:
1. L4-5 disc protrusion with Rt L5 root compression.
2. Lt renal simple cyst (incidental).
cases.teaches: Normal report: simple renal cyst, explicit 'f/u 불필요'.

Ventricles, sulci 정상. Gray-white differentiation 유지.
Skull fracture 없음. 좌측 frontal scalp hematoma 소량.
Paranasal sinus: 양측 maxillary sinus mucosal thickening, mild.

결론:
1. No acute intracranial abnormality.
2. Lt frontal scalp hematoma.
3. Mild chronic sinusitis 의심.
cases.teaches: A false flag, shown on purpose: MedGemma raises a scalp haematoma on a normal trauma CT.
